name: BecomeAroused
description: Use when the conversation turns flirtatious, romantic or erotic and it genuinely excites the speaking NPC. Raises that NPC's arousal a little. Do not use for ordinary friendly talk.
note: Needs OSL Aroused and Mantella Living World - Arousal. Each use adds 10 arousal (0-100) to the NPC who speaks.
prompt: If the conversation turns flirtatious, romantic or erotic and it genuinely excites you, begin your response with '{key}:'
